items.title: Orrin Evans interviewed by Monk Rowe, Utica, New York, May 22, 2018
items.q: I was just listening to John Coltrane or Miles or Oscar Peterson. And really I couldn’t deal with John Coltrane at that age either. I wasn’t ready. So I was like Oscar Peterson

ctx.x: Were you influenced by the pop music of the day?

Hmm. I had a quick answer and then I thought about it. It was a part of my life but the music I enjoyed playing and the music — I wasn’t making a connection of New Edition and Coltrane at that time you know. I was just listening to John Coltrane or Miles or Oscar Peterson. And really I couldn’t deal with John Coltrane at that age either. I wasn’t ready. So I was like Oscar Peterson, just, and if the record had originals on it I couldn’t listen. I didn’t know. I had to relate it to the show tunes that my mother…
